info.name: Gymai Member App API (v1)
info.description:
Member mobile app API.

**Flow:** Check version → Send OTP → Verify OTP → Get gym branding.

Run the requests in order. The test scripts save values into collection variables automatically:
- **Send OTP** stores `otp` (from `debug_otp`, only returned when `OTP_EXPOSE_IN_RESPONSE=true` in a non-production environment) and `gym_id`.
- **Verify OTP** stores `token` and `gym_id`.

All authenticated requests send `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

**Response format**
- Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { ... } }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "code": "ERROR_CODE", "data"?: { ... }, "errors"?: { ... } }`

**Error codes:** VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHENTICATED, NO_GYM_CONNECTED, MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, MULTIPLE_GYMS, OTP_COOLDOWN, OTP_LIMIT_REACHED, OTP_NOT_FOUND, OTP_EXPIRED, OTP_INVALID, OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED, MEMBER_INACTIVE, GYM_NOT_FOUND, GYM_INACTIVE, ALREADY_CHECKED_IN, ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT, NOT_CHECKED_IN, NO_ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP, SELF_CHECKIN_DISABLED, PLAN_NOT_FOUND, FORBIDDEN, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, NOT_FOUND.

exec: if (d.force_update) { console.log('FORCE UPDATE → ' + d.store_url); } else if (d.update_available) { console.log('Optional update available: ' + d.latest_version); }

request.description:
Call on app launch.

- `force_update: true` → installed version is below the minimum supported version. Block the app and send the user to `store_url`.
- `update_available: true` → a newer version exists. Show an optional update prompt.
- `maintenance.enabled: true` → show `maintenance.message`.

Versions are managed by the Super Admin in **Platform → Settings → Member mobile app**.

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit OTP by SMS to a registered, active member.

**Body**
- `phone` (required) — any format: `9876543210`, `+91 98765 43210`, `09876543210`.
- `gym_id` (optional) — required only when the number belongs to members of more than one gym (see the *Send OTP — choose gym* request).

**Rules:** OTP valid 5 minutes · resend allowed after 30 s · max 5 OTPs per number per hour.

`debug_otp` is included only when `OTP_EXPOSE_IN_RESPONSE=true` and the app is not in production.

**Not connected to any gym (fallback):** if the number is not an active member of any active gym (never registered, deactivated or removed by their gym, or their gym is suspended), the API returns `404 NO_GYM_CONNECTED` with `data.callback_requested: true`. The number is saved as a **lead** in Super Admin → App Leads and a support executive calls back with nearby gyms.

Optional lead fields (used only in that case): `name`, `city`, `latitude` + `longitude` (for gyms near the user), `app_platform`, `app_version`.

response.name: OTP sent
Not connected to any gym (saved as lead)
Number registered at multiple gyms
Resend too soon

request.description: Use after a `409 MULTIPLE_GYMS` response: set `gym_id` to the gym the member picked, then send again. Pass the same `gym_id` to *Verify OTP*.

Verifies the OTP and returns a Sanctum **Bearer token** plus the member's `gym_id` (use it for the branding API).

**Body**
- `phone` (required)
- `otp` (required, 6 digits)
- `gym_id` (optional — only if it was needed for Send OTP)
- `device_name` (optional — shown when listing/revoking tokens)

An OTP can be used once. After 5 wrong attempts it is locked; request a new one.

response.name: OTP expired

request.description: Revokes the current token (other devices stay logged in).

Branding for the member's gym (`gym_id` from Verify OTP). Requires the Bearer token.

Returns logo, banner, colours, tagline, description, contact, social links, opening hours, facilities and photos.

**Errors**
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` — missing/invalid/revoked token
- `403 FORBIDDEN` — `gym_id` is not the member's gym
- `403 GYM_INACTIVE` — gym is suspended/deactivated (`data.gym_status`)
- `403 MEMBER_INACTIVE` — the gym deactivated this member (token is revoked)
- `404 GYM_NOT_FOUND` — no such gym

request.description:
Data for the home-screen streak card. Requires the Bearer token and an active gym.

- `current_streak` — visit days in the live streak ("12 DAY STREAK")
- `visits_this_month` — "18 visits this month"
- `week` — Mon→Sun dots. `status`: `attended` (filled ✓), `missed` (empty), `closed` (gym closed that day), `today` (dashed — not checked in yet), `upcoming`
- `at_risk` — true when skipping today would break the streak (show a nudge)
- `next_milestone` — e.g. 2 more visit days to reach 14
- `rules.grace_days` — rest days allowed between visits (set by the gym)

Streaks update automatically on every check-in.

State for the CHECK IN NOW button.

`state`: `not_checked_in` → show **Check in now** · `checked_in` → show **Check out** · `checked_out` → visit done.
`self_checkin_enabled: false` → hide the button and ask the member to show their QR at the desk.

Member checks themselves in (the CHECK IN NOW button). Returns the attendance and the refreshed streak so the card updates immediately.

**Errors:** `409 ALREADY_CHECKED_IN` · `403 NO_ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP` · `403 SELF_CHECKIN_DISABLED` (gym turned it off) · `403 GYM_INACTIVE`.

response.name: Checked in
Checked out

request.description:
Everything the member can see for one type:
- `custom` — plans made only for this member (show first, e.g. "Made for you")
- `categories` — the gym's categories, each with its default plans
- `uncategorized` — default plans without a (visible) category

Only published plans are returned. Plans are summaries; open one with *Get plan detail*.

response.name: Example

request.description:
Full plan with its sections in order. Each section can have a title, subtitle (time / sets × reps), text (`body`, keep line breaks) and a photo (`image_url`).

`404 PLAN_NOT_FOUND` — the plan doesn't exist, is unpublished, belongs to another member, or another gym.
